content: C9-A plain-fn recursion: add FnItem.dec: Option<Clause> (ast) + parse_fn optional trailing dec after fx (parser); lower_fn emits decreases <spec_dec> when dec.is_some() reusing the spec-fn/loop machinery (lower); validator detects direct self-call (block_calls_name) and emits MissingDecreases when dec absent and not fx diverge (the #88 exemption honored); grounded conformance test (recursion_conformance.rs) — L3 with dec, L0 non-decreasing, MissingDecreases no-dec, L1 diverge, builds+runs. Additive dec field rippled to FnItem literals as dec: None. Mutual recursion (REQ-6) deferred.
